home_faq1_answer: For people and businesses looking for help, and professionals looking for their next project. This can include designers, tutors, photographers, event assistants or people who can repair things at home.
home_faq2_answer: In Shkodër, Albania. We're starting with local skills and everyday projects close to home.
home_faq3_question: Does the work have to take place on-site?
home_faq3_answer: It depends on the job. A repair requires someone on-site; design, writing and some tutoring sessions can take place remotely. Discuss directly where and how the work will be done.
home_faq4_question: Can I book someone right now?
home_faq4_answer: This is a preview of the NextJob homepage. You can explore services and download a project brief or professional introduction. Live profiles, job listings and bookings are not connected yet.
home_faq5_question: Who agrees on the price and schedule?
home_faq5_answer: The customer and professional should agree directly on what the job includes, how much it costs and when it will take place before starting work.

landing_hero_description: Find the right professionals for your projects or discover new opportunities to offer your skills. NEXTJOB connects people and services in one place.
landing_intro_text1: Finding suitable people for specific tasks can take time. NEXTJOB provides a digital way to publish jobs, offer services and find suitable offers.
landing_intro_text2: From skilled trades and repairs to creative and digital projects, NEXTJOB brings different services together on one platform.
landing_how_description: Four steps to connect employers and workers.
landing_step1_text: Register on NEXTJOB and create your personal profile to use the platform.
landing_step2_text: Search available jobs, explore different categories and find tasks that match your skills.
landing_step3_text: Employers can describe their tasks, add important details and make jobs visible to other users.
landing_step4_text: Send offers, exchange information and organize collaboration on a job.
landing_categories_title: What jobs can you find on NEXTJOB?
landing_categories_text: Discover different services, projects and tasks across various fields.
landing_employer_image: The right support for your project.
landing_employer_text: Do you need help with a specific task? With NEXTJOB you can describe your job and provide information so workers understand your task better.
landing_employer_step1_text: Create an account to publish jobs.
landing_employer_step2_text: Enter a title, category, location, budget and detailed description.
landing_employer_step3_text: Publish your task so interested workers can discover it.
landing_employer_step4_text: Review received offers and worker profiles.
landing_employer_step5_text: Discuss further details with a suitable worker.
landing_worker_text: Do you offer services and seek new tasks? On NEXTJOB you can present your profile, discover available jobs and send suitable offers.
landing_worker_step1_text: Add personal information and describe your services.
landing_worker_step2_text: Present your skills, experience and areas of work.
landing_worker_step3_text: Browse jobs and use the available search functions.
landing_worker_step4_text: Save jobs you want to view again later.
landing_worker_step5_text: Send the employer an offer for the requested work.
landing_features_title: More than just a job search.
landing_features_text: Features that simplify connecting people and organizing services.
landing_feature1_text: Search available tasks and discover different services.
landing_feature2_text: Users can present information, experience and skills on their profiles.
landing_feature3_text: The platform enables communication between employers and workers.
landing_feature4_text: Reviews can help users assess experiences with other users.
landing_feature5_text: Users can manage their jobs, profiles and activities on the platform.
landing_feature6_text: NEXTJOB is accessible on different devices and designed for mobile screens.
landing_faq_text: Answers to the most important questions about NEXTJOB and using the platform.
landing_faq1_answer: NEXTJOB is a digital platform connecting employers and workers. Employers can publish tasks and projects, while workers can find suitable jobs and send offers.
landing_faq2_question: How can I publish a job on NEXTJOB?
landing_faq2_answer: After registering, you can create a job. Enter a title, description, category, location and other important information. You can then publish the job.
landing_faq3_question: How do I find suitable jobs?
landing_faq3_answer: Workers can use the job search to browse available jobs. Keywords and filters help them discover suitable tasks and view job details.
landing_faq4_answer: NEXTJOB supports various services, including construction, cleaning, gardening, repairs, graphic design, marketing and digital services.
landing_faq5_question: How can I send an offer?
landing_faq5_answer: Once you find a suitable job, you can view its details and send an offer for the requested work. The employer can then compare the offers.
landing_faq6_answer: Yes. Users can manage their profiles and add relevant information, personal details, skills and experience so others can learn more about them.
landing_faq7_question: Can I use NEXTJOB on my phone?
landing_faq7_answer: NEXTJOB is designed for different screen sizes. The platform can be used on desktop computers, tablets and smartphones.
